svg.title: MZI amplitude and phase modulator — simplified symbol
svg.desc: Editable, annotation-free functional symbol with one optical input on the left and one selected optical output on the right. A symmetric split-arm-recombine motif represents a Mach–Zehnder modulator. Two gold actuator marks and electrical control terminals represent independently controlled arm phase shifts. Their reference connections and detailed electrodes are omitted. Differential arm phase controls transmission magnitude; common arm phase controls output phase. For ideal balanced splitting and recombination, the selected transmission is exp(i phi_average) cos(delta_phi/2), up to a fixed coupler phase. Rejected optical power leaves through an omitted complementary channel or radiation/termination modes, depending on implementation. The branches are functional symbols, not a physical mask or a claim of lossless three-port operation. Actuator technology, voltage range and bandwidth are unspecified. Continuous pale gray optical guides and blue cores match the component library. No overall enclosure is drawn. All artwork is native editable SVG on a transparent background, with separate layers for optical cladding, optical cores and electrical control symbols.
